presets.name: Soweto Street Corner
presets.prompt: Vibrant Soweto street at dusk, colourful murals on brick walls, minibus taxis queueing, street vendors selling vetkoek, kids playing soccer in the road, warm orange streetlights, laundry hanging between houses

presets.name: Durban Beachfront
presets.prompt: Durban Golden Mile beachfront at sunrise, Indian Ocean waves crashing, surfers with boards, promenade crowded with families, rickshaws with colourful umbrellas, curry bunny chow stalls, humid salty air

presets.name: Table Mountain
presets.prompt: Table Mountain at sunset, Cape Town skyline below, cable cars moving, fynbos plants in foreground, city bowl lights turning on, Atlantic Ocean on one side, mountains covered in pink and gold light

presets.name: Johannesburg Taxi Rank
presets.prompt: Chaotic Johannesburg taxi rank at rush hour, dozens of minibus taxis colourful and loud, drivers shouting destinations, commuters rushing with bags, street food sellers, diesel smoke, urban energy

presets.name: Traditional Shebeen
presets.prompt: Dimly lit shebeen tavern in the township, corrugated iron walls, neon beer signs, people laughing and playing cards, umqombothi in shared containers, kwaito music from an old radio, wooden tables

presets.name: Rural Limpopo Village
presets.prompt: Rural Limpopo village at golden hour, traditional rondavel huts with thatched roofs, maize fields stretching to hills, women carrying water on heads, children chasing chickens, goats wandering, red clay soil

presets.name: Bo-Kaap Cape Town
presets.prompt: Bo-Kaap colourful houses in Cape Town, cobblestone streets, bright blue, pink, and yellow painted homes, mosque minaret in distance, Cape Malay spice scents, laundry on lines, mountain backdrop

presets.name: Kruger National Park
presets.prompt: Kruger National Park savanna at dawn, acacia trees silhouetted, mist over watering hole, elephants and antelope grazing, safari jeep with tourists, golden grass, African sky full of stars

presets.name: Victoria Street Market Durban
presets.prompt: Durban Victoria Street Market, narrow aisles packed with spices in pyramids, incense smoke, Indian clothing fabrics, jewellery stalls, shoppers bargaining, aroma of curry and chai, bustling multicultural crowd

presets.name: Gauteng Mine Dump
presets.prompt: Gauteng mine dump landscape at twilight, reddish-yellow earth mounds, mine headgear silhouettes against the sky, township shacks at the base, distant city lights, industrial and gritty atmosphere
